name: Ermine Proof
tagline: Prove your Birkin is a Birkin before some stranger on the internet decides for you.
positioning: Ermine Proof authenticates luxury goods for the people actually selling them — not white-glove concierges, just you and a phone camera at your kitchen table.

hero.h1: Fakes are getting good. So are we.
hero.sub: Snap eight photos, wait about ninety seconds, and get a signed authentication report you can staple to any listing. No shipping your handbag to a warehouse in another timezone.

features.title: Ninety-second verdicts
features.description: Photo-based authentication for handbags, sneakers, watches and jewelry. You get a real, defensible verdict before the buyer's cold feet set in.

features.title: Reports buyers trust
features.description: Every pass ships with a shareable certificate, confidence score, and the exact stitch-count and hardware notes our model flagged. No vibes, receipts.

features.title: A grader who's seen it all
features.description: Borderline cases get bumped to a human authenticator with fashion-house credentials. They've handled 400,000 bags and still gasp at nothing.

features.title: Provenance that follows the item
features.description: Each report gets a permanent ID. Resell it in three years and the certificate is still valid, still linked, still yours.

features.title: Dispute armor
features.description: Sold something and got hit with a 'this is fake' chargeback? Forward the report. We back it with a resolution guarantee up to your item's value.

features.title: Batch mode for the closet-flippers
features.description: Uploading forty items from an estate sale? Queue them all, grab coffee, come back to a spreadsheet of verdicts.

testimonials.quote: I flip vintage Chanel on the side and used to sweat every listing. Now I attach an Ermine Proof report and buyers stop haggling. The dispute guarantee paid for itself the first month.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

testimonials.quote: We route every intake through Ermine Proof before it hits our floor. Their human graders caught a superfake Rolex our old vendor waved through. That alone justified switching.
testimonials.name: Marcus Devlin

testimonials.quote: I bought a 'deadstock' Jordan pair, ran the photos, and got a polite 'absolutely not' in under two minutes. Chargeback filed, money back, ego intact.
testimonials.name: Sofia Bianchi

pricing.blurb: For the once-in-a-while seller cleaning out a closet.
For side-hustlers who list every week and hate chargebacks.
For full-time flippers and small consignment shops.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ermine Proof authenticates luxury goods for the people selling them. Real reports, real graders, no warehouse road trips for your handbag.
